newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Monday. One barge traded versus none on Friday.
- One barge, Spring Valley, Illinois River, on station, traded at 100 percent of tariff.
- One barge, Mississippi (Memphis), $500 switched, this week, offered 90 percent of tariff - unchanged from Friday.
One barge, Cincinnati, Ohio River, on station, no bid, offered at 95 percent, no comparison.
